asset.name: IconButton
asset.description: The compact icon-only action with a mandatory accessible name, expanded touch target beyond its visual bounds, tooltip integration, loading state, and optional toggle semantics.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Variant styling is declared as an enumerable recipe so the implementation is checkable against the catalog.
Pointer, touch, keyboard, press, and focus-visible behavior is owned once rather than reimplemented.
The glyph resolves through the registry so weight and direction stay consistent.

suggests.reason: Icon-only controls in dense toolbars usually need a name on hover, though a labelled context may not.

rationale: The asset most likely to fail the tap-target floor, because its visual size and its touch target are legitimately different and the expansion has to be deliberate.
